items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: I mean Maurice White is you know, they were doing, not hip-hop and jazz, but they were doing funk and soul and jazz.

ctx.x: I have one or two more questions. For the record, you’ve covered David Bowie songs, he just passed. Maurice White Earth Wind & Fire just passed. Speak about those two in terms of your thoughts about them in particular.
Oh yeah. I mean Maurice White is you know, they were doing, not hip-hop and jazz, but they were doing funk and soul and jazz.
